reviewNotes: Bull shark: live underwater lateral view, stout body and short blunt snout. Reject handled juvenile and distant surface-fin candidates.
Bluefin: breaching live fish, no boat, people or size scale. Identification viewport focuses head/shoulder. Reject catch photos, detached remains and distant underwater silhouette.
Halibut: close live underwater head, both eyes visible on eyed side. Reject catch/deck, scale and washed-out surface photos.
Lionfish: sharp underwater head/striped body. Reject catches, measuring mat, crocodile predation and dark overhead candidates.
No photographic bytes edited. Viewports preserve aspect ratio. Backgrounds remain natural and varied.
Cartoon proportions are illustration choices, not measured body-size cues. Species appearance may still suggest answers.
